name: O-acetylbufotenine
summary: O-Acetylbufotenine, or bufotenine O-acetate, also known as 5-acetoxy-N,N-dimethyltryptamine (5-AcO-DMT) or O-acetyl-N,N-dimethylserotonin, is a synthetic tryptamine derivative and putative serotonergic psychedelic.

pharmacology.text: O-Acetylbufotenine, or bufotenine O-acetate, also known as 5-acetoxy-N,N-dimethyltryptamine (5-AcO-DMT) or O-acetyl-N,N-dimethylserotonin, is a synthetic tryptamine derivative and putative serotonergic psychedelic.

uses.text: The effects of O-acetylbufotenine in humans have not been assessed or reported. Alexander Shulgin speculated about O-acetylbufotenine in his 1997 book TiHKAL (Tryptamines I Have Known and Loved), but did not personally synthesize or test it.

summaryZh: 5-AcO-DMT是一種色胺衍生物，化學式為C14H18N2O2，可通過血腦屏障，並代謝為蟾毒色胺。
summaryZhHans: 5-AcO-DMT是一种色胺衍生物，化学式为C14H18N2O2，可通过血脑屏障，并代谢为蟾毒色胺。

sideEffects.en: Its effects in people have not been reported. Drugs of its class, the tryptamine psychedelics, can cause nausea, a faster heart rate, anxiety, confusion and frightening experiences that may lead to risky behaviour.
sideEffects.zh: 它在人體的作用尚無報告。它所屬的色胺類迷幻藥，可能引起噁心、心跳加快、焦慮、混亂，以及可能導致危險行為的驚恐體驗。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它在人体的作用尚无报告。它所属的色胺类迷幻药，可能引起恶心、心跳加快、焦虑、混乱，以及可能导致危险行为的惊恐体验。

fact.en: Bufotenine, its parent, is found in some toad skin secretions, in Anadenanthera seeds used to make snuff in South America, and in certain mushrooms.
fact.zh: 它的母體化合物蟾毒色胺存在於某些蟾蜍的皮膚分泌物、南美用來製作鼻煙的 Anadenanthera 種子，以及部分蘑菇中。
fact.zhHans: 它的母体化合物蟾毒色胺存在于某些蟾蜍的皮肤分泌物、南美用来制作鼻烟的 Anadenanthera 种子，以及部分蘑菇中。
